video.title: How to Start a $1M Online Business WITHOUT "Gimmicks"!

summary: The Niche Pursuits host contrasts fragile online loopholes with businesses built around real customer problems. He describes his past niche websites, his Long Tail Pro software business, and products including a thin pillow and Link Whisper, then lists seven models he considers risky. His five-step framework is to solve a real problem, work directly with customers, build an email audience, diversify beyond algorithms, and recruit affiliates. The central takeaway is that durable products and customer relationships offer more control than income dependent on platform rules or trends.
